recentItems.title: INSIDE 'SHEESH MAHAL': Kapil Mishra Mocks Kejriwal's 'Common Man' Image As BJP Shows His Luxury Home
recentItems.description:
Times Now takes you inside Sheesh Mahal as Delhi Minister Kapil Mishra takes a swipe at former Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal's 'common man' image. From a luxury gym, jacuzzi and sauna to a Rs 28 lakh television, Rs 13 lakh chandelier and expensive furniture, the BJP puts the lavish interiors of Kejriwal's former residence on display. The party alleges that around Rs 58 crore was spent on the property. Watch the exclusive report.

recentItems.title: Frankly Speaking With Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla: India's Space Journey, Gaganyaan & More
recentItems.description:
Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla, India's astronaut who travelled to the International Space Station (ISS), joins Frankly Speaking for an exclusive conversation on his extraordinary journey from fighter pilot to astronaut. 
From the challenges of astronaut training, the thrill of launch and life aboard the ISS to India's ambitions under the Gaganyaan programme, Shukla shares insights into India's evolving space journey, international collaboration and what it takes to venture beyond Earth.

recentItems.title: US Air Force Under Attack? Hackers Breach Flagship Cloud Platform: Troop Data, War Secrets Stolen?
recentItems.description:
US Air Force Cloud One has reportedly been breached by hackers, triggering a major cybersecurity investigation involving US Cyber Command. The platform supports sensitive military applications, including logistics, aircraft maintenance and command-and-control systems. The full extent of the breach, the identity of the attackers and whether any data was stolen remain unclear.
